package_files.policy.json: schema_version=1, actor=mlp|lstm, observation_size, action_size, exact observation_layout, environment, kinematics, source checkpoint/step, weights_sha256
package_files.weights.npz: FP32 exported actor and frozen normalizer; allow_pickle=False
package_files.golden.npz: observations[T,B,D], resets[T,B], actions[T,B,7] from original training actor; include resets and all controller phases; finite values only

phase_observation.warning: Only 50D policies trained with this exact phase convention. Do not append a dummy phase to a 49D network.

action_contract: normalized [-1,1]: base-frame linear/angular twist commands (6) and gripper action (1); NOT direct joint/CAN commands
action_scales: Preserve exported max_lin_vel, max_ang_vel, gripper mode/threshold/rate; do not reinterpret as joint targets.

coordinate_contract.rotations: same quaternion to rotation-vector convention as training; cube symmetry is not silently rewritten

limitations: Raw Orbax checkpoints require a matching exporter in the external training project. Studio does not guess an export configuration.
49D SHOW-100 baseline validated with the actual export. 50D phase adapter has contract/unit tests but no new SHOW-103 export has been validated.
Mock uses a fake plant, not physics or pick-and-place success evaluation. Recorded input inspection uses synthetic arm state.
Live execution must use matching live camera/calibration and robot feedback, never prerecorded video. Camera/SAM ownership is not switched automatically.
Force 0.5 is the SDK gripper effort parameter, not arm stiffness or a measured contact force.
Physical model properties, scale/geometry accuracy, learning environment/rewards and final sim2real validation remain external.
